Rust

Paradigm: Multi-paradigm

Designed by: Graydon Hoare

First appeared: 2010

Rust (programming language)

Rust is a multi-paradigm, general-purpose programming language that emphasizes performance, type safety, and concurrency.

It enforces memory safety—guaranteeing that all references point to valid memory—without requiring a garbage collector.
